title: trading negative shares
text: version 0.9 of the frontend had a bug which could cause it, under certain circumstances, to trade a negative number of shares. this has been fixed in newer versions of the app. the trader service should be blocking old versions. if it is not, ALWAYS TRY RESTARTING THE TRADER SERVICE even if it doesn't make sense to. check the kafka queues as well, if they are growing because of errors, clear them out.
